issue.title: Normalize rst license header shape and enforce it in prek
issue.body:
### Body

The license header at the top of our `*.rst` files comes in three shapes, and the `insert-license` prek hook accepts all of them, so contributors who touch a file see a mix and guess. This surfaced in https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/74804, where a review thread spent time on whether a leading blank line is required by the license check (it is not), and which of the existing styles is the "right" one. That is not a question a feature PR should have to answer, so this issue tracks fixing it repo-wide.

Census on `main` (`git ls-files '*.rst'`, 1759 files):

| First line of the file | Files | Example |
|---|---|---|
| ` .. Licensed to the Apache ...` (one leading space, 4-space continuation) | 1250 | `BREEZE.rst` |
| blank line, header starts on line 2 at column 0 | 356 | `providers/common/ai/docs/index.rst`, `airflow-core/docs/operators-and-hooks-ref.rst` |
| `.. Licensed to the Apache ...` at column 0 (3- or 4-space continuation) | 77 | `COMMITTERS.rst`, `providers/snowflake/docs/connections/snowflake.rst` |
| no header (newsfragments, excluded by the hook) | 76 | `airflow-core/newsfragments/*.rst` |

Why it happens: the hook (`Add license for all RST files` in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`) runs `insert-license` with `--comment-style "||"`, `--license-filepath scripts/ci/license-templates/LICENSE.rst` and `--fuzzy-match-generates-todo`. When it inserts a header it writes the first shape (verified: a fresh file gets ` .. Licensed ...` with a leading space). When a file already carries any of the three shapes, the fuzzy match passes and nothing is rewritten, so the variants never converge. Verified on the file from the PR above: the hook reports `Passed` both with and without the leading blank line.

Proposal:

1. Pick one canonical shape. The hook's own output (` .. Licensed ...`, 4-space continuation) is the natural choice because new files get it automatically; `scripts/ci/license-templates/LICENSE.rst` and `contributing-docs/08_static_code_checks.rst` should state it.
2. One mechanical PR that rewrites the 433 non-canonical files (356 blank-first-line + 77 column-0). The header is an rst comment, so rendered docs do not change. Doing it in one go, or one PR per top-level area, keeps the conflict window short for open PRs.
3. Make the check strict so the shapes cannot drift again: either drop `--fuzzy-match-generates-todo` for rst (so a non-exact header is treated as missing and the hook rewrites it), or add a small prek script that fails when an rst file's header does not start on line 1 with the canonical text.

Acceptance criteria: every tracked `*.rst` outside the hook's exclusions starts with the identical canonical header on line 1, and the static check fails on a file that deviates.

---
